opportunities.title: Real Estate Platform Web & Apps
opportunities.description: # JOB TITLE: Full-Stack Website & Mobile App Developer – Real Estate Property Management Platform # Project Overview We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Developer or Development Team to design, develop and deploy a modern real estate website, customer management portal and cross-platform mobile application (Android and iOS) for **J-Crest Estates Limited**. The project involves building a digital property ownership and installment payment platform targeting Nigerians, young professionals, low-income earners and Nigerians in the diaspora. The platform will allow customers to browse properties, subscribe without an initial down payment on qualifying offers, make flexible installment payments and monitor their property ownership progress digitally. ### 1. Website Development Develop a professional, mobile-responsive website featuring: - Homepage and company profile. - Property listings and search functionality. - Property development and affordable housing. - Flexible property ownership programmes. - Property investment and diaspora services. - Customer registration and login. - Online property subscription applications. - Contact and enquiry management. ### 2. Customer Dashboard Develop a secure customer portal featuring: - Personal customer accounts. - Property subscription management. - Real-time payment history. - Outstanding balance calculator. - Daily, weekly, biweekly and monthly payment options. - Property ownership progress tracker. - Digital receipts and account statements. - Buy-back application portal. - Customer service and complaint management. - Automated payment reminders and notifications. ### 3. Mobile Application Development Develop Android and iOS mobile applications with functionality similar to the website's customer portal. The mobile application should include: - Customer registration and secure login. - Property browsing and subscription. - Payment integration. - Customer wallet/account balance display. - Payment history and digital receipts. - Outstanding balance tracking. - Property ownership progress. - Buy-back applications. - Customer support and complaint tickets. - Push notifications. - Profile and account management. The mobile application and website must operate on the same backend and database, ensuring real-time synchronization. ### 4. Admin Dashboard Develop a comprehensive administration portal with: - Customer management. - Property and inventory management. - Subscription approval and management. - Payment verification and reconciliation. - Outstanding balance monitoring. - Ownership progress management. - Receipt and statement generation. - Buy-back application management. - Complaint and customer support management. - Notifications and announcements. - Financial and operational reporting. - User roles and permissions. ### 5. Payment and Third-Party Integrations Integrate: - Paystack. - Flutterwave. - Bank transfer verification where supported. - Email and SMS notifications. - WhatsApp Business API where applicable. - Push notification services. - Electronic document signing integration. Support international customers and multiple currency displays, with Nigerian Naira as the primary accounting currency. ### 6. Technical Requirements The developer should have experience with: - React / Next.js or equivalent frontend technologies. - Laravel / Node.js or equivalent backend technologies. - MySQL / PostgreSQL databases. - Flutter or React Native for mobile applications. - REST APIs and third-party integrations. - Cloud hosting and deployment. - Secure authentication and role-based access control. - Payment gateway integration. - Mobile application publishing on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. The architecture must be scalable, secure, API-driven and capable of supporting future expansion. ### 7. Design and Branding The platform should have a premium international real estate technology appearance. Brand colours: - Deep forest green. - Gold. - White. - Charcoal accents. Brand slogan: Building Assets. Creating Wealth. Securing Legacies. The website and mobile applications must have consistent branding and user experience. ### 8. Expected Deliverables The successful developer will be responsible for: 1. Complete website design and development. 2. Functional customer portal. 3. Complete administrative dashboard. 4. Android mobile application. 5. iOS mobile application. 6. Backend development and database architecture. 7. Payment gateway integrations. 8. API documentation. 9. Testing and quality assurance. 10. Deployment and hosting configuration. 11. Google Play Store and Apple App Store submission support. 12. Source code and complete project handover. 13. Technical documentation and maintenance support. ### 9. Developer Qualifications Applicants should demonstrate: - Proven experience developing real estate platforms. - Previous fintech or payment integration experience. - Experience building customer dashboards. - Proven Android and iOS application development. - Ability to develop secure administrative systems. - Portfolio of completed projects. - Ability to provide ongoing technical support. ### 10. Application Requirements Interested developers or development teams should submit: - Company or developer profile. - Portfolio and links to previous projects. - Examples of real estate or fintech applications developed. - Proposed technology stack. - Recommended hosting infrastructure. - Project implementation timeline. - Detailed cost breakdown separating website, backend, Android and iOS development. - Post-deployment maintenance and support costs. **Important:** We require a fully functional production-ready solution, not merely a website template, frontend demonstration or prototype. All modules must connect to a working backend and database. **Project Owner:** J-Crest Estates Limited. **Project Type:** Website + Backend + Android + iOS Mobile Application. **Engagement:** Freelance Contract / Development Team. We welcome proposals from qualified individual developers and established software development companies.

opportunities.description: Busco guionista para series cortas de redes sociales (2 minutos) Estoy buscando un guionista creativo que tenga experiencia desarrollando historias originales y atractivas para vídeos cortos de aproximadamente 2 minutos, destinados a TikTok, Instagram Reels y Facebook. ¿Qué necesito? * Crear historias originales, impactantes y con potencial viral. * Escribir guiones que enganchen al espectador desde los primeros 3 segundos. * Desarrollar historias con emoción, suspenso, giros inesperados y finales memorables. * Utilizar una narrativa dinámica que mantenga la atención hasta el último segundo. Importante: El trabajo consiste exclusivamente en desarrollar la historia y escribir el guion. No necesito edición de vídeo, grabación, locución ni producción audiovisual. Busco una persona creativa, con imaginación, excelente capacidad narrativa y conocimiento de lo que funciona en las redes sociales. La idea es comenzar con algunos guiones de prueba y, si existe buena química creativa, establecer una colaboración recurrente. opportunities.title: Claude Automation for Insurance Brokerage
opportunities.description: Looking for an experienced Claude (Anthropic) specialist to automate as much of our day-to-day work as possible for a small Australian insurance brokerage (Queensland based). The goal is maximum efficiency: fewer clicks, less manual data entry, more done end-to-end by Claude. What I need help with: - Building and refining Claude Skills (SKILL.md files) so repeatable workflows run with minimal input: renewals, quotes, client emails/SMS and certificates of currency - Connecting Claude directly to our business systems via MCP connectors / APIs, including our insurance systems, Microsoft 365 / Outlook and WordPress - Setting up Claude in Chrome / Cowork automations for browser-based insurer portals - Identifying bottlenecks and streamlining workflows so tasks that take hours take minutes - Documenting and handing over so we can keep improving the skills ourselves Ideal freelancer: - Proven hands-on experience with Claude Skills, MCP servers and the Anthropic API (please share examples) - Comfortable with REST APIs, OAuth and Microsoft 365 - Focused on practical, time-saving results rather than theory - Australian timezone (AEST) or good overlap preferred; insurance or financial services experience a bonus Starting with a small paid first task, with ongoing work for the right person. Please include relevant experience and your hourly rate in your bid.

Key Requirements: - The robot will handle sheets, pillow cases, or towels pieces. - Its primary task is to pick up these and place them into a folding machine. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in robotics and automation - Experience with two-arm robotic systems - Familiarity with material handling and integration with industrial machines - Background in programming robots for specific tasks Must be able to create a clear plan and be able to execute the plan in a reasonable time and with in budget. Travel and on site installation and training of at least the training staff to carry on the project System will need to have self learning and improving technology and Communication in English or Chinese System must have operation repair and parts documentation System must be able to work continuously, be reliable to remain functioning for years, durable to handle production conditions, and meet human speeds. Location of this is in Canada Please provide relevant experience and any similar projects completed.

opportunities.title: Editor Gameplays y Reels Dinámicos
opportunities.description: Cuento con grabaciones de series completas de gameplay y quiero publicarlas en YouTube y Facebook en formato largo, además de extraer los mejores momentos para clips verticales que funcionen en Instagram Reels y TikTok. Para los episodios extensos solo necesito una edición limpia: corta silencios, elimina tiempos muertos y deja el audio parejo; nada de efectos recargados. En cambio, los clips breves sí deben sentirse ágiles y llamativos, resaltando las jugadas clave con cortes rápidos y, cuando sume, un pequeño zoom o texto que enfatice la acción. Entrego los archivos fuente y espero los videos finales en 1080p: • Gameplay completo en 16:9, listo para subir. • Pack de clips verticales (9:16) de entre 15 y 60 s cada uno. Una muestra inicial lo antes posible me ayudará a confirmar estilo; no será demasiado contenido, por lo que la rapidez es importante. Quedo atento a cualquier duda técnica sobre códecs o formatos para que podamos avanzar de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Story-Driven 3D Animation Production
opportunities.description: I need a complete 3D animation that centres on original characters and a clearly told story. From first concept through to the final render, every move, expression, and camera cut should serve the narrative and keep viewers engaged to the very last frame. Here is what has to happen: • Character-focused storyline – design or adapt memorable protagonists, define their world, and build a short but impactful narrative arc. • Full 3D pipeline – modelling, rigging, texturing, animation, lighting, and rendering carried out in a professional toolset such as Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or Cinema 4D (whichever you work fastest in while still delivering high quality). • Final delivery – a polished video ready for upload (minimum Full HD, 25 fps or 30 fps), plus all working project files so further tweaks remain possible. Please outline: • How you handle storyboarding and character approvals. • The typical turnaround for each production stage. • Any extras you can supply, like voice-over coordination or sound design. If you have relevant samples showing strong character animation and narrative flow, share the links—they will help me lock in the right partner quickly.

opportunities.description: I need a punchy, 10-second 3D cartoon spot with that unmistakable Pixar-like charm. The micro-story is simple: a hilarious household mishap kicks things off, the unlucky hero taps my mobile app with a quick voice alert, a 10 km radar graphic pulses to life, and a five-star superhero handyman streaks in to set everything right—all before the viewer can finish laughing. The tone has to hook both kids and parents in those first seconds, so timing, facial reactions, squash-and-stretch physics, and expressive lighting are key. Please keep the pacing brisk: two seconds for the accident, two for the voice alert, two for the map radar, and the final four for the hero’s dramatic arrival and instant fix, ending on my app logo. Send over links to comparable 3D cartoon work you’ve already completed and quote a single fixed price that includes full commercial rights. If selected, I’ll supply logos, UI screens, and any colour references you need right away. Deliverables: • 10-second final video in 1080p (ProRes or high-quality H.264) • Clean version plus version with embedded SFX/music • All usage transferred to me in writing at hand-off Ready to laugh? Show me your funniest samples and your best all-in price so we can get this flying hero on screen.

opportunities.title: Humanize Graduate Academic Writing
opportunities.description: I’m sitting on several graduate-level papers that still read like they were churned out by a bot. The arguments, evidence, and formatting are all there—I simply need each piece re-crafted so the prose feels unmistakably human, nuanced, and appropriate for a professional program. Your job is to preserve every idea, citation, and structural requirement while giving the language natural flow, varied syntax, and an authentic scholarly voice that will stand up to AI-detection checks. Because these are academic submissions, clarity, logical progression, and formal tone matter just as much as sounding natural, so I’m looking for someone comfortable polishing research writing at the graduate level. I need the first file turned around ASAP, with the remaining pieces following quickly after we confirm the style is on point. Deliverables: • Finalised, ready-to-submit documents in Word (tracked changes visible) • A clean version of each piece • Brief note on any sections that required substantive rework • Turnitin report of work If you’ve got a keen editorial eye, experience with tools like Grammarly or Turnitin, and the ability to humanise AI-generated text without losing its academic rigour, I’d love to start right away.

opportunities.description: PLEASE READ FIRST — HOW PAYMENT WORKS: We do NOT pay for marketing, advertising, or leads. Any marketing you do — including ALL ad spend — is 100% at your own cost and risk. We pay ONLY for results: $15 for each CONFIRMED enrolled student — a student who completes the free trial AND pays the first monthly fee. That $15 is the only payment, released through a Freelancer milestone only after the student's first fee is received. If your method requires an ad budget from us, please do not bid. Assalamu alaikum, We run Sana Online Quran House, an established online Quran academy offering 1-to-1 live classes for kids and adults: Noorani Qaida, Nazra Quran, Tajweed, Hifz (memorization), and Islamic studies. We have male and female teachers, flexible timings for US time zones, a free assessment, and a 3-day free trial. Website: sanaquran.online The job: Bring us Muslim parents in the USA who are genuinely looking for online Quran classes for their children (or for themselves), and guide them to message us on WhatsApp and book the free trial. How you are paid — per result, not per promise: - You are paid $15 for every enrolled student — a student who completes the free trial AND pays the first monthly fee. - This project is a test milestone: the first 5 enrolled students = $75 total. - All payments go through Freelancer milestones only. Nothing is paid in advance and nothing is paid outside Freelancer. - If the quality is good, this becomes a long-term, ongoing arrangement. Rules (please read before bidding): - Real marketing only: Facebook/Instagram/Google ads, community and group outreach, SEO, content — your choice, but it must be genuine. - No purchased lists, no bots, no scraped data, no fake or incentivised sign-ups. Such leads will not be paid for. - The parent must have contacted us themselves and must know it is about online Quran classes. - Tell us in your bid: (1) exactly how you will generate the students, (2) any similar work you have done for academies, tutors, or education businesses, (3) how many enrolled students you realistically expect in the first 2 weeks. We reply fast and we pay on time for real results. Long-term work is available for the right person.

opportunities.description: NOW HIRING: REMOTE CUSTOMER SERVICE & CLIENT SUCCESS SPECIALIST $500 SIGN-ON BONUS | $5–$7/HR + COMMISSION | WEEKLY PAY | FULL-TIME REMOTE Customer Service • Client Relations • Sales • CRM Management • Career Growth Are you an experienced customer service professional with excellent English communication skills, a passion for helping people, and the ambition to earn more than an hourly paycheck? Excess Elite, a growing U.S.-based surplus funds recovery company, is seeking a motivated, independent, money-driven professional to join our remote team! This is more than an ordinary virtual assistant position. You’ll help manage customer relationships, generate business opportunities, operate advanced AI technology, and grow into a leadership role. WE PAY FOR EXPERIENCE AND REWARD RESULTS! WHY JOIN OUR TEAM? * $500 SIGN-ON BONUS! * $5–$7 USD hourly starting pay * Weekly payments * $25 per qualifying signed client agreement * 10% commission on qualifying net company recovery revenue * Paid major holidays * Double-time pay for approved holiday shifts * Paid birthday off or double-time birthday pay * Performance reviews and potential raises every 90 days * Monthly performance bonuses * Complimentary vacation reward after 3 qualifying successful case payouts * Leadership and career advancement opportunities * 100% remote, long-term opportunity SIGN-ON BONUS: $250 after 30 days and $250 after 60 days of satisfactory active employment, subject to written bonus terms. ABOUT EXCESS ELITE When properties sell through foreclosure or tax auctions, they sometimes generate more money than the outstanding debts and expenses. The remaining proceeds are known as surplus funds. Depending on state laws, former property owners, heirs, and other eligible individuals may be entitled to recover these funds. Some cases involve $10,000, $50,000, $100,000, or more! Our company identifies these opportunities, locates potential claimants, helps coordinate authorized agreements, and works with legal professionals throughout the recovery process. Our mission is to provide exceptional customer service while helping eligible individuals pursue funds that may rightfully belong to them. YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES CUSTOMER SERVICE & CLIENT RELATIONS * Answer incoming inquiries and make outbound calls. * Build relationships with prospective and existing clients. * Explain company services clearly and professionally. * Answer questions, handle objections, and provide updates. * Follow up with interested prospects and active clients. * Assist with paperwork and electronic agreements. * Maintain accurate communication records. * Deliver outstanding customer service. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH * Research foreclosure auctions, tax sales, and public records. * Identify potential surplus funds opportunities. * Research property owners and possible heirs. * Use approved social media accounts and lawful research tools. * Upload, organize, and verify leads daily. * Maintain accurate CRM records. * Prioritize promising opportunities. * Develop and manage your own portfolio of leads. CRM, AI & AUTOMATION You’ll help manage our Excess Elite CRM, including: * Customer databases and lead pipelines. * Integrated power dialers and calling campaigns. * SMS, email, and automated follow-ups. * AI voice agents and automation tools. * Lead tracking and case management. * Client communications and campaign monitoring. * Workflow improvements and troubleshooting. Experience with GoHighLevel, Excess Elite, power dialers, AI agents, or similar CRM platforms is a major advantage. CLIENT ACQUISITION & CONTRACTS * Contact prospective claimants. * Explain our services and answer questions. * Follow up on interested leads. * Send approved agreements for electronic signature. * Track unsigned and completed agreements. * Coordinate documentation with attorneys. * Monitor case progress and client satisfaction. * Help increase conversions through professional follow-up. FIELD MARKETING & TEAM COORDINATION * Recruit and coordinate door knockers and field representatives. * Create recruitment advertisements. * Assign approved territories and lead lists. * Provide scripts and instructions. * Monitor field activity and results. * Coordinate client follow-ups. * Eventually assist with hiring and training additional agents. DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS * Manage daily activities with minimal supervision. * Maintain organized client and lead pipelines. * Prepare daily performance reports. * Track calls, agreements, follow-ups, and case progress. * Identify problems and implement solutions. * Communicate regularly with company ownership. * Help improve operational efficiency. * Grow into a team leadership or operations management position. WE WANT SELF-STARTERS, PROBLEM SOLVERS, AND FUTURE LEADERS! COMPENSATION — GET PAID FOR YOUR PERFORMANCE! BASE PAY: $5–$7 USD PER HOUR Higher compensation negotiable for exceptional experience. PAID WEEKLY! PLUS $500 SIGN-ON BONUS! PLUS $25 PER QUALIFYING SIGNED AGREEMENT! PLUS 10% COMMISSION ON QUALIFYING NET COMPANY RECOVERY REVENUE! EXAMPLE: $100,000 SUCCESSFUL CLAIM * Total surplus recovered: $100,000 * Illustrative company recovery fee: $30,000 * Attorney payment: $10,000 * Net company revenue: $20,000 * Your 10% commission: $2,000 * Signed agreement bonus: $25 YOUR POTENTIAL BONUS & COMMISSION: $2,025! That’s in addition to your hourly wages! Actual earnings depend on successful case completion, company collections, applicable laws, and the written commission agreement. Commissions are not guaranteed. BUILD YOUR OWN BOOK OF BUSINESS! We provide the technology, CRM, research resources, dialers, and business infrastructure. You develop opportunities, manage client relationships, and help grow the business. Your earning potential increases with successful performance. AMAZING BENEFITS & REWARDS COMPLIMENTARY VACATION: Earn a company-sponsored vacation reward after 3 qualifying successful case payouts, subject to the travel benefit policy. 90-DAY PERFORMANCE REVIEWS: Opportunities for hourly raises based on performance. MONTHLY BONUSES: Additional incentives for outstanding productivity, client service, and successful results. PAID HOLIDAYS: Eligible team members receive paid designated major holidays. Approved holiday work earns double-time pay. PAID BIRTHDAY: Enjoy your birthday off with pay! Approved birthday shifts earn double-time pay. CAREER ADVANCEMENT: Opportunities to become a Senior Customer Service Specialist, Acquisition Manager, Team Leader, or Operations Manager. We want talented people who grow WITH the company! WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR We’re seeking someone who is: * Fluent in spoken and written English. * Experienced in customer service, sales, or client relations. * Confident making outbound calls. * Comfortable handling objections and following up. * Organized, dependable, and detail-oriented. * Motivated by commissions and performance incentives. * Experienced with CRM software and digital tools. * Comfortable learning AI and automation technology. * Independent and capable of solving problems. * Professional, ethical, and accountable. * Interested in a long-term career. BONUS EXPERIENCE: Real estate, surplus funds, foreclosure research, legal intake, skip tracing, appointment setting, GoHighLevel, or remote team management. Previous surplus funds experience is helpful but not required for candidates with strong transferable skills. NO CONSTANT HAND-HOLDING. WE WANT INITIATIVE, SOLUTIONS, AND RESULTS! WORK SCHEDULE MONDAY–FRIDAY 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EASTERN TIME Full-time remote position, 40 hours weekly. You must have a dependable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and excellent English communication skills. HOW TO APPLY SERIOUS, EXPERIENCED APPLICANTS ONLY! Please submit: 1. Resume: Relevant customer service, sales, or management experience. 2. Voice Recording: A 60–90 second English introduction explaining your experience and why you’re a strong candidate. 3. DISC Assessment: Your DISC personality assessment results or another reputable workplace personality assessment. 4. Desired Hourly Rate: Your expected compensation in USD. 5. Technology Experience: CRM systems, dialers, AI tools, and automation platforms you’ve used. 6. Biggest Achievement: Describe how you’ve helped customers, generated revenue, closed deals, or improved business operations. YOUR NEXT CAREER OPPORTUNITY STARTS HERE! We’re not building an ordinary call center. We’re developing a growing, technology-driven surplus funds recovery business focused on customer service, innovation, and long-term success. WE PROVIDE THE TOOLS. YOU BRING THE TALENT, HUNGER, AND DEDICATION! If you’re looking for weekly pay, a $500 sign-on bonus, meaningful commissions, paid benefits, vacation rewards, and the opportunity to become a future business leader, WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU! APPLY TODAY AND GROW WITH EXCESS ELITE!

opportunities.title: CRM Performance Optimization, Bug Fixes, AI Integration
opportunities.description: Project Overview I have an existing web-based CRM platform designed to streamline communication between my internal team, third-party partners, and customers. The platform helps manage customer relationships, coordinate meetings, track activities, and improve customer support and daily business operations. The core application has already been developed but there are some issues to be fixed before deployment. The main challenges are high latency, slow data loading, and data integrity issues that affect application performance and reliability. I am looking for an experienced full-stack developer to identify and resolve these issues, stabilize the existing system, and implement basic AI chatbot and PDF document automation features. Scope of Work 1. Performance Optimization & Bug Fixes (Priority) • Investigate and resolve high latency and slow application response times. • Optimize Supabase queries, database access, and frontend API requests. • Identify and fix data integrity issues, including inconsistent, missing, or duplicate records. • Improve database operations, validation, and data synchronization. • Resolve authentication, permission, form, and CRM workflow bugs. • Review unnecessary API calls, rendering bottlenecks, and inefficient data fetching. • Improve error handling and overall application stability. • Test and verify the affected workflows. 2. AI Chatbot Integration • Integrate a basic AI chatbot using OpenAI APIs. • Implement a simple, user-friendly chat interface. • Support business-related questions and meeting preparation. • Connect the chatbot to a limited set of authorized CRM data where feasible. • Ensure secure API communication and basic conversation management. 3. PDF OCR & Document Automation • Extract information from PDF documents using text parsing or OCR. • Convert extracted information into structured JSON. • Map predefined fields to relevant CRM records. • Implement basic validation to prevent incorrect or duplicate data. • Allow users to review and confirm extracted information before saving to Supabase. Expected Deliverables • Measurable improvements in application latency and response times for agreed workflows. • Resolved priority bugs and data integrity issues. • Optimized Supabase queries and API operations. • Functional basic AI chatbot integration. • Basic PDF extraction and data-mapping workflow. • Clean, maintainable code Required Skills • React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Python • Supabase, PostgreSQL, Authentication, RLS • Database optimization, indexing, and query performance analysis • REST API development and performance debugging • Data integrity, validation, and transaction handling • OpenAI API and LLM integration • OCR, PDF parsing, and structured data extraction • Experience debugging and optimizing existing SaaS or CRM applications Proposal Requirements Please include: • Relevant experience with React, Supabase, and performance optimization • Examples of similar CRM, SaaS, or AI integration projects • Your approach to diagnosing high latency and database integrity issues • Estimated timeline and fixed-price quote I am looking for a reliable developer who can investigate performance bottlenecks, maintain database consistency, troubleshoot existing code independently, and deliver practical, maintainable solutions within the agreed scope.

opportunities.title: Realistic Tractor Pulling Simulator
opportunities.description: I want to turn my tractor-pulling concept into a true-to-life simulator. The core of the project is authenticity: engine power curves, precise gear changes, and weight balance must feel exactly right while the sled and dirt track react to every bump, rut, and change in ground grip. A small PC prototype will be our first milestone—one tractor, one sled, and a short pull that already showcases accurate physics and convincing sound. From there we can refine ballast placement, expand tractor classes, add tuning options, and polish visuals. Show me your experience with vehicle or heavy-equipment sims, physics programming, and engines such as Unreal or Unity. Briefly outline the toolchain you would use for 3D assets, audio, and version control, and explain how you plan to build the underlying physics that make each pull feel real. If you have shipped or modded similar projects, even better. Let’s create the most believable tractor-pulling game on the market.

opportunities.title: Warm Modern Villa Interior Design
opportunities.description: أعكف حالياً على وضع هوية داخلية متكاملة لفيلا خاصتي وأحتاج إلى مصمم يستطيع تحويل الأفكار إلى مخططات دقيقة وعروض ثلاثية الأبعاد جذابة. جميع الفراغات ستكون ضمن نطاق العمل: غرف المعيشة والاستقبال المتعددة، غرف النوم والحمامات، المطبخ ومناطق تناول الطعام، المساحات الخارجية الملاصقة والمسبح. أرغب في مزيج عصري دافئ يوظّف الخشب والحجر والخامات الطبيعية ليمنح كل غرفة طابعاً فريداً مع بقاء الخط العام متناغماً عبر كامل الفيلا. ما ستحصل عليه من جانبي هو: • مخططات هندسية كاملة تتضمن أبعاد الغرف. • ملفات توضح مواقع الأبواب والنوافذ والخدمات. ما أحتاجه منك: • مقترح توزيع أثاث مفصّل لكل مساحة. • مود بورد أولي يوضح المواد والألوان المقترحة قبل الانتقال إلى النمذجة. • صور وفيديوهات ثلاثية الأبعاد واقعية عالية الدقة (رندر نهائي) تُبرز الإضاءة الطبيعية والاصطناعية وخيارات الخامات. يفضَّل العمل على أدوات احترافية مثل AutoCAD أو Revit للمخططات، ثم 3ds Max/SketchUp مع V-Ray أو Lumion للرندرة، أو ما يعادله طالما يحقق النتيجة المرجوة. سأراجع كل مرحلة على حدة للتأكد من انسجام الفكرة والالتزام بالأبعاد الدقيقة، لذلك احرص على إمكانية التعديل قبل الإخراج النهائي. بمجرد اعتماد التصميم، أود استلام ملفات المصدر كاملة إلى جانب الرندرات بصيغة JPEG/PNG 4K وفيديو قصير إن أمكن لإحاطة شاملة بالمشروع.

opportunities.title: Comprehensive Authorized Forum Archive Scraper
opportunities.description: A comprehensive web scraping solution designed to extract, collect, organize, and archive the complete publicly accessible structure and content of a forum platform similar to SkyscraperCity.com The platform systematically captures forum categories, subforums, discussion threads, individual posts, images, attachments, member profiles, moderators, administrators, and associated metadata, preserving the original relationships between all elements. ### Core Features **1. Forum Structure Extraction** - Complete forum directory and category hierarchy. - All main forums and subforums. - Forum descriptions and navigation structure. - Thread listings and pagination. - Forum statistics and activity indicators. **2. Discussion & Thread Extraction** - All authorized discussion topics. - Complete post content and replies. - Thread titles, URLs and descriptions. - Publication dates and modification dates. - Author usernames and post references. - Quotes, embedded links and discussion relationships. **3. Image & Media Extraction** - Images attached to discussions. - Original image URLs and available resolutions. - Image galleries and thumbnails. - Attachments and downloadable media where authorized. - Automatic organization by forum, thread and post. **4. Members & User Directory** - Public member profiles. - Usernames and profile URLs. - Registration dates and public profile information. - Public activity statistics. - Member contributions and discussion history. **5. Administration & Moderation Directory** - Public administrator profiles. - Public moderator profiles. - Assigned forum moderation roles. - Forum-specific moderation structure. - Publicly displayed staff information. **6. Data Management & Export** - Structured PostgreSQL database. - JSON and CSV exports. - Complete image and media archive. - HTML archive of discussions. - Duplicate detection and URL normalization. - Preservation of original forum relationships. - Searchable and indexed content. ### Technical Architecture The system uses an automated crawling engine, HTML parsing, browser automation when required, pagination management, image processing, database integration and structured data exports. ### Final Objective Create a comprehensive, searchable and organized digital archive of an authorized forum, preserving its complete discussion architecture, historical content, visual media, public member directory and public administration structure. The resulting dataset should be suitable for research, historical preservation, data analysis, content migration and the development of a new community platform. :::

opportunities.title: Python AI Email Automation Platform
opportunities.description: I’m looking to build an AI-powered automation platform in Python that focuses first on streamlining my Gmail / Google Workspace inbox. The core goal for this initial phase is to handle everyday email duties automatically—sorting incoming messages into the right labels, drafting intelligent replies, and sending timed follow-ups so nothing slips through the cracks. The system needs to connect securely to Gmail via the official API, monitor new messages in real time, run classification and priority rules, generate context-aware responses with an LLM (OpenAI or similar), and queue follow-ups based on configurable triggers. An internal dashboard or CLI where I can adjust rules, review generated replies before they are sent, and track automation logs will be essential. Everything should be written in clean, well-documented Python, making use of standard libraries plus any necessary helpers like google-api-python-client, LangChain, or FastAPI for the control layer. Deliverables: • A Python codebase ready to deploy locally or on a small cloud instance • OAuth-based Gmail/Workspace integration with token refresh handling • Email sorting, reply drafting, and follow-up scheduling working end-to-end • Simple UI or CLI to review, approve, or edit outgoing mail • README and setup script so I can run it with minimal fuss I’ll consider the first milestone complete once I can connect my Gmail account, watch the service label and prioritize new mail automatically, see suggested replies, and confirm that scheduled follow-ups send on time without manual intervention. Later phases may expand to reporting and cross-system data entry, but for now the focus is 100 % on conquering the inbox.

opportunities.title: Pelatihan Kerja Online Ponsel
opportunities.description: Saya ingin menambah penghasilan tanpa meninggalkan kebun sawit, jadi saya memutuskan fokus pada pekerjaan online yang bisa dikerjakan hanya lewat ponsel. Aktivitas yang paling saya kuasai adalah mengetik dan membalas chat dalam Bahasa Indonesia serta bahasa daerah saya. Saya membutuhkan seorang mentor berpengalaman yang dapat: • Menjelaskan cara kerja platform freelance atau marketplace chat support yang bisa diakses lewat ponsel. • Membimbing saya membuat profil hingga siap menerima job pertama. • Memberi contoh skrip dan etika membalas chat agar respons cepat, sopan, dan jelas. • Memberikan daftar aplikasi atau situs yang memang menerima pekerja remote berbahasa Indonesia. • Menyediakan latihan praktis—minimal satu simulasi proyek chat support—dan umpan balik langsung. • Mendampingi saya selama proses pendaftaran dan saat mendapatkan order pertama (melalui WhatsApp/Zoom). Saya belajar paling efektif lewat demonstrasi langsung dan tanya-jawab singkat. Tolong jelaskan metode mentoring Anda, durasi pendampingan, serta contoh sukses murid sebelumnya bila ada.

opportunities.title: BLS Visa Portal Automation Platform
opportunities.description: Senior Python Automation Developer Needed — BLS Spain Visa Appointment System (Algeria: Algiers & Oran) I am looking for an experienced developer to build a full-cycle appointment monitoring and booking-assistance automation system for the official BLS Spain Visa portal serving Algeria. So the project details is : BLS Appointment Automation Bot — Windows Desktop Application I want to develop a Windows desktop application that automates the BLS appointment monitoring and booking preparation process. Core Requirements The bot should provide the following functionality: 1. Automatic Appointment Monitoring: Continuously monitor the BLS appointment system to detect available appointment slots. 2. Instant Notifications: Immediately notify the user whenever a new appointment slot becomes available. 3. Configurable Monitoring Intervals: Allow the user to configure how frequently the bot checks appointment availability. 4. Automated Booking Workflow: Assist with the appointment booking process and handle the required steps reliably, without unnecessary interruptions. 5. Personal Information and Applicant Data: Handle the applicant’s information accurately and ensure that the required details are entered correctly. 6. Payment Workflow: Support the official payment process using the Algerian Edahabia (Gold Card), ensuring that the payment flow is handled reliably and that payment status is properly verified. 7. Booking Page Access: Once an appointment becomes available and the required steps are completed, automatically open the official booking or payment page so the user can proceed with and complete the remaining process. Critical Reliability Requirements My highest priority is the reliability and stability of the application. I want to minimize errors, interruptions, failed operations, and unexpected behavior throughout the entire workflow. In particular, I want special attention given to preventing, diagnosing, and properly handling the following HTTP errors: HTTP 501 — Not Implemented HTTP 403 — Forbidden The application should include robust error detection, logging, recovery mechanisms, and appropriate retry strategies. It must clearly identify the cause of failures rather than repeatedly retrying requests without understanding the underlying problem. Final Objective Deliver a reliable, user-friendly Windows desktop application that continuously monitors BLS appointment availability, immediately alerts the user when an appointment becomes available, and supports the subsequent booking and official payment workflow with maximum operational stability.

Booking Page Access: Once an appointment becomes available and the required steps are completed, automatically open the official booking or payment page so the user can proceed with and complete the remaining process. I want to minimize errors, interruptions, failed operations, and unexpected behavior throughout the entire workflow. It must clearly identify the cause of failures rather than repeatedly retrying requests without understanding the underlying problem. opportunities.title: AI Shopify Store Automation Expert
opportunities.description: Shopify Developer with Strong Claude/ChatGPT Experience (Ongoing Agency Work) We're DonutLabs, a Melbourne digital agency doing web design, SEO and AI automation for Australian businesses. We need a Shopify developer who uses AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day in their work, not just now and then. This is ongoing work across several client stores. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Theme customisation and fixes (Liquid, Online Store 2.0, sections and blocks) - Product, collection and metafield setup, bulk imports and data clean-ups - Speed, SEO and structured data improvements - Building AI-assisted workflows for product descriptions, catalogue updates, reporting and automations - Working with the Shopify Admin API and apps where needed WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 3 years of hands-on Shopify development - Real, practical experience using Claude and/or ChatGPT to build or speed up Shopify work (prompts, API integrations, scripts, agents or automations) - Clear communication and good English, with enough overlap with Melbourne hours (AEST/AEDT) - Bonus: Shopify Plus, the GraphQL Admin API, Shopify Flow, MCP or AI agent tools, catalogues with thousands of products HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY) Your bid must start with these 4 things, in this order, before anything else: 1. Your own website (your business or portfolio site, not a freelancer profile) 2. A link to a client Shopify store you built or worked on 3. A link to a second client Shopify store 4. Whether this bid was written by you, by AI, or by AI on behalf of a human. Be honest, because if you lie, you'll be rejected automatically. Bids that don't open with these 4 things will be declined without being read. After that, include only: - What you did on each store - At least one example of Shopify work you've done with Claude or ChatGPT (a Loom video, GitHub repo or live demo): what the problem was, how you used the AI and what the result was - Your hourly rate in AUD and your availability per week Budget: hourly, ongoing, with the rate depending on experience.

opportunities.title: Telegram Chat Reply Templates
opportunities.description: I need a simple solution that lets my support admin answer incoming Telegram messages straight from the regular Telegram app, yet still have access to a set of quick-reply templates for common questions. The goal is to speed up response times without forcing the admin to leave the native interface or switch to an external web dashboard. Here’s how I picture it working: • When a customer message arrives, the admin stays inside Telegram, selects or triggers one of the predefined templates, makes edits if needed, and sends. • All templates must be easy for me to edit or add later—ideally through a concise command, a lightweight panel, or a file I can update quickly. • Anything you build must comply with Telegram Bot API policies and run reliably on a modest VPS or cloud function. Your deliverable should include the running bot (or relevant integration), clear setup instructions, and brief documentation on how to maintain or expand the template list. If you have done something similar, share that past work so I can gauge fit.

opportunities.title: Commission-Based B2B Sales and Marketing Outreach
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a sales-minded freelancer who wants to be paid strictly on results. Your mission is simple: bring in new clients for our agency’s web development, IT infrastructure & automation, and digital marketing services, then collect an aggressive commission on every dollar the client spends. Here’s how it works I’ll arm you with a concise pricing guide, clear service overviews, and proven talking points so you can approach prospects with confidence. You choose the outreach mix—cold email, LinkedIn messages, social DMs, even direct calls, anything ethical that consistently books discovery calls or closes deals outright. When a project is signed and the client’s first payment clears, you receive a large one-time cut. If the engagement turns into an ongoing retainer, you keep earning a percentage each month for as long as the client stays with us. What I consider a win • A qualified prospect booked into my calendar with basic project details, or • A deal you’ve closed end-to-end using our paperwork and price sheet. Ideal partners are self-starters who already know their way around B2B outreach tools and enjoy the thrill of closing. If that sounds like you, tell me briefly about a deal you sourced from scratch and the outreach tactic that made it happen. Let’s start earning together.

opportunities.title: Female Storytellers for AI Roleplay Chats - 3
opportunities.description: Romance Conversation with AI bot for human data and AI training. I am hiring 10 freelancers to do Story base roleplay chats with our AI models, Anonymous chats, no names involved, goal is to do story based real life chat for AI training. Chats needed to be done on FB platform, and we prefer freelancers with laptop or desktop. Chat theme is girls to girls chat, so male please do not apply. This task is like story telling, we give you Role play story plot and you add 100s of your own details around it and make up a story in your mind and chat with the AI bot, so AI bot get's that training data. Chat is only text based, not voice or video. We need freelancers to be in age range of 22 to 35 year, and freelancers from india, pakistan and nepal and UAE are only invited. So if you are not from any one of this countries please do not apply. 1st rule.. when you send me message, never ever send with AI generated text, we want real humans not another AI bot. if your sentence are not well articulated and you have grammar and spelling mistakes, that is completely fine. That's what we are hiring you for .. raw data if you are story-teller, or article writer or content writer or SEO person who understands content, you might do well in this job. budget is perfectly INR 750 for 1 hour of chat, if you are good - you might get more milestones afterwards, but at first you should apply for exactly 750 Rs, anyone applying for any other amount will be discarded. to apply first tell me your favorite color in first sentence of your proposal.

opportunities.title: Playful 2D Character Animation
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a project that calls for lively, cartoon-style character animation. The goal is to bring a fun, engaging persona to life with smooth motion and expressive poses that feel truly playful. Here’s what I need from you: • A fully animated 2D character in a bright, cartoon and playful style – think bold shapes, clear silhouettes, and exaggerated expressions. • Clean, polished movement at 24 fps (or higher if you prefer) delivered in 1080p or 4K. • Final exports in a transparent-background format (PNG sequence or ProRes 444) plus an H.264 preview for quick review. • The editable source file from your preferred software (Toon Boom Harmony, Adobe Animate, After Effects with DUIK/Joysticks, etc.) so I can make tweaks later if needed. I’ll provide the character design, script snippets, and any timing notes as soon as we agree on the scope. If you handle rough thumbnails, key poses, and in-betweens, I’ll review each stage rapidly so we can keep momentum. Let me know your usual turnaround for the rough pass, clean-up, and final render, and feel free to share any past examples that show how playful and expressive your character work can be.

opportunities.title: Recuperar cuenta hackeada juego
opportunities.description: Me han comprometido la cuenta de una plataforma de juego / entretenimiento y el soporte oficial no ha resuelto el problema. Sigo teniendo acceso al correo electrónico asociado, lo que puede facilitar la verificación de identidad, pero el atacante cambió la contraseña y la autenticación secundaria. Busco a un especialista en seguridad informática que domine técnicas de recuperación de cuentas y análisis de incidentes. Necesito: • Restaurar el acceso completo y permanente a la cuenta. • Identificar y revertir cualquier cambio de datos (correo, número de teléfono, métodos de pago, etc.). • Indicarme los pasos técnicos aplicados para que pueda justificarlos ante el soporte de la plataforma si fuera necesario. • Reforzar la seguridad: contraseñas robustas, 2FA, buenas prácticas y recomendaciones para evitar futuros ataques. Requisitos clave – Solo métodos legales y acordes a los términos de la plataforma. – Confidencialidad absoluta sobre la información de la cuenta y mi identidad. – Comunicación clara en español y disponibilidad para acompañarme en tiempo real si la plataforma envía códigos o enlaces de verificación al correo. Entregarás el acceso restituido, un breve informe técnico de las acciones realizadas y una lista de medidas preventivas. Si necesitas datos adicionales (capturas, encabezados de correos, número de ticket de soporte, etc.) puedo proporcionarlos de inmediato. Espero tu propuesta y plazo estimado para devolverme mi cuenta.

opportunities.title: Precise PDF Floorplan Conversion
opportunities.description: I need several scanned floor-plan PDFs recreated as native DWG files that can go straight to our contractor. These are building layouts, so the geometry has to hold up to onsite tape-measure checks—please work to exact dimensions, not a rough overlay. Every wall, door, window and room name shown on the scans must appear in the CAD file and sit on sensible layers with clean polylines. Keep line weights consistent, snap corners accurately, and retain the original sheet scale so printed plots read 1:1 against the PDF. Deliverables • One DWG per sheet, compatible with AutoCAD 2018 or earlier • All text styles and dimensions editable in model space • A brief note confirming any assumptions or missing information you encountered If you have examples of similar PDF-to-DWG conversions you’ve done, feel free to share a snippet so I can see your line quality before we begin.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "I need several scanned floor-plan PDFs recreated as native DWG files that can go straight to our contractor. These are building layouts, so the geometry has to hold up to onsite tape-measure checks—please work to exact dimensions, not a rough overlay. Every wall, door, window and room name shown on the scans must appear in the CAD file and sit on sensible layers with clean polylines. Keep line weights consistent, snap corners accurately, and retain the original sheet scale so printed plots read 1:1 against the PDF. Deliverables • One DWG per sheet, compatible with AutoCAD 2018 or earlier • All text styles and dimensions editable in model space • A brief note confirming any assumptions or missing information you encountered If you have examples of similar PDF-to-DWG conversions you’ve done, feel free to share a snippet so I can see your line quality before we begin."

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Developer (Next.js / React / Node.js) – SaaS Platform Development
opportunities.description: Project: Blacksheet – Course Creation & Business Management Platform We are building Blacksheet, an all-in-one platform for course creators, coaches, and digital entrepreneurs. The platform aims to simplify how creators build, manage, and sell their digital products, courses, memberships, and online businesses. We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Developer ( individual, no company ) or teams to first audit our existing codebase, then work on specific development tasks, and eventually help us build a complete website and sales funnel system with a visual page builder similar to ClickFunnels and GoHighLevel. This is an ongoing development opportunity for someone who can understand an existing SaaS architecture and contribute to building a scalable product. Phase 1: Existing Codebase Audit The first assignment will be to conduct a comprehensive audit of our existing Blacksheet platform. Responsibilities: * Review the existing frontend and backend architecture. * Analyze code quality, structure, and maintainability. * Identify bugs, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues. * Review API integrations and database architecture. * Identify incomplete features and potential architectural problems. * Evaluate the platform’s production readiness. * Provide a detailed audit report with prioritized recommendations. We want someone who can understand the existing system rather than immediately rewriting things. Phase 2: Course Template Development After the initial audit, the next assignment will involve developing a course template using Next.js and integrating it with our existing backend. Responsibilities: * Develop a dynamic course template using Next.js. * Connect the template with existing backend APIs. * Dynamically render course content, modules, lessons, and other relevant data. * Integrate the existing custom domain connection functionality. * Generate a working preview URL through a connected domain. * Ensure the template communicates correctly with the existing platform. * Implement responsive layouts and ensure a good user experience. Important: The custom domain connection functionality is already implemented. You will be working with the existing functionality rather than building it from scratch. Phase 3: Website System & Visual Page Builder Once the initial assignments are completed successfully, we plan to work together on building a complete website and funnel-building system for Blacksheet. The goal is to develop a flexible website-building experience comparable to ClickFunnels and GoHighLevel. The system will include: 1. Website Management System * Create and manage multiple websites. * Website settings and configurations. * System pages and reusable layouts. * Custom domain and publishing integration. 2. Landing Page & Funnel System * Create landing pages. * Build sales funnels with multiple steps. * Manage funnel navigation and page relationships. * Create sales, checkout, thank-you, and other funnel pages. * Connect pages with existing products, offers, and backend functionality. 3. Visual Drag-and-Drop Page Builder * Visual page editing experience. * Drag-and-drop elements and sections. * Reusable sections and components. * Responsive editing for desktop, tablet, and mobile. * Styling and layout controls. * Save, preview, and publish functionality. * Integration with the existing backend and website rendering system. The objective is to build a flexible system that allows users to create complete websites, landing pages, and sales funnels without writing code. Required Technical Skills * Strong experience with Next.js and React. * Solid JavaScript and TypeScript knowledge. * Experience with Node.js and REST API integration. * Experience working with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM. * Understanding of SaaS application architecture. * Experience with dynamic rendering and reusable frontend components. * Understanding of authentication, permissions, and multi-tenant systems. * Good understanding of responsive frontend development. Preferred Experience Experience with any of the following would be a major advantage: * Building visual drag-and-drop page builders. * Developing website builders or landing page builders. * ClickFunnels or GoHighLevel architecture. * Dynamic website rendering systems. * Custom domain and subdomain integrations. * Funnel-building platforms. * Multi-tenant SaaS applications. How We Plan to Work We prefer a phased engagement rather than handing over the entire project at once. 1. Start with a paid code audit. 2. Move to a fixed-price course template development assignment. 3. Based on performance, continue with hourly development work on the website system and page builder. 4. Potentially establish a long-term development relationship. We are building an MVP, so the focus is on practical implementation, clean architecture, and prioritizing essential functionality over unnecessary complexity. We don’t expect everything to be enterprise-grade from day one, but the code should be structured so the platform can grow without requiring major rewrites. To Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your experience with Next.js, React, Node.js, and SaaS development. 2. Examples of website builders, page builders, or similar platforms you have developed. 3. Have you previously built a drag-and-drop visual page builder? If yes, please share examples. 4. How would you approach auditing an existing SaaS codebase before making changes? 5. Your hourly rate and availability. Please share actual projects or working examples wherever possible. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of development tasks, understand the bigger product architecture, communicate clearly, and grow with the platform over the long term.

opportunities.title: Zoho Client Finder: Paid Only for Clients Who Sign
opportunities.description: I'm an experienced Zoho developer (5+ years) working with Zoho CRM, Desk, Books, Flow, Forms and Deluge scripting. opportunities.title: Booth Sales Representative Needed
opportunities.description: I will have a stand at World Ag Expo, February 9-11, 2027 (9 AM – 5 PM) at the International Agri Center, 4500 S. Laspina St, Tulare, CA. For these three show days I need one energetic, English-speaking sales representative to stay in the booth and engage every qualified visitor. Your priorities • Collect each visitor’s business card or write down full contact details. • Encourage them to add my Chinese manager on WhatsApp by displaying the QR code or entering the number on their phone. • Focus conversations on farm owners & growers, agricultural equipment dealers, and distributors/importers. How to approach visitors 1. Open with a concise introduction of our company and key products. 2. Ask about their farming operation or business needs to gauge interest level. 3. Invite them to scan the QR code or add our WhatsApp so I can follow up after the show. End-of-day deliverables • A well-organised stack of business cards and/or a digital contact list (name, company, position, phone, email, WhatsApp status). • Brief notes on each lead’s product interests or questions. Logistics I will provide the badge, product brochures, QR code signage, and a short training sheet before the show opens. Please be on site 30 minutes before doors each day and presentable in business-casual attire. If you are outgoing, reliable, and comfortable initiating conversations, I look forward to working with you at the booth.

opportunities.title: Gestión Instagram para Campeón BMX
opportunities.description: Hola, mucho gusto. Estoy buscando una persona que gestione el Instagram de mi hijo, un deportista ecuatoriano de BMX Racing de 8 años. Él es campeón Panamericano, campeón Latinoamericano y tres veces campeón del Ecuador. Actualmente está entrenando y compitiendo en Canadá, vinculado a Supercross, preparándose para el Mundial de Francia 2027. Su Instagram tiene más de 6.000 seguidores. Queremos mejorar su imagen deportiva, publicar videos profesionales de sus entrenamientos y competencias, crecer orgánicamente y conseguir mayor visibilidad para futuros patrocinadores. Nosotros proporcionamos los videos y fotografías. Buscamos a alguien que se encargue de editarlos, preparar y publicar contenido y gestionar la estrategia de crecimiento, siempre bajo nuestra supervisión como padres. Nuestro presupuesto es de USD $100 a $200 mensuales. ¿Podrías ofrecerme un paquete mensual dentro de ese presupuesto? Me gustaría conocer ejemplos de tus trabajos, cuántos Reels y publicaciones incluirías y cómo organizaríamos el trabajo.

opportunities.title: Teleoperador B2B para Restaurante Ibiza
opportunities.description: Titolo Teleoperador/a freelance B2B para restaurante en Ibiza – Campaña local Descrizione da pubblicare Somos Carpe Diem, un restaurante y pizzería con servicio de delivery en Ibiza. Buscamos un/a teleoperador/a freelance con experiencia en llamadas comerciales B2B y residencia en España. El proyecto comenzará con una campaña de prueba dirigida exclusivamente a empresas, oficinas y comercios situados aproximadamente a un máximo de 10 minutos en coche del restaurante. No buscamos contactar con empresas de toda la isla, sino con negocios cercanos cuyos empleados puedan venir a comer, celebrar una comida de empresa o solicitar nuestro servicio de delivery. Trabajo a realizar * Crear una primera lista de 50 empresas cercanas, utilizando únicamente datos empresariales públicos. * Incluir empresa, sector, zona, teléfono, email o WhatsApp comercial si está disponible y enlace de Google Maps o página web. * Entregar la lista para nuestra aprobación antes de comenzar las llamadas. * Contactar solamente con las empresas aprobadas. * Intentar hablar con la persona responsable o encargada. * Presentar brevemente Carpe Diem y nuestras propuestas para empresas. * Promocionar, según la campaña, comidas para empleados, delivery, promociones especiales, menús para grupos y comidas o cenas de empresa, incluyendo eventualmente un menú especial de Navidad. * Detectar si existe interés y solicitar autorización para enviar la información por WhatsApp o email. * Registrar cada llamada y su resultado en una hoja compartida de Google Sheets. Nosotros proporcionaremos el guion, la propuesta comercial, las promociones y las respuestas a las principales objeciones. No es necesario cerrar la venta por teléfono. El objetivo es encontrar empresas interesadas y obtener permiso para enviarles nuestra propuesta. Las llamadas se realizarán en bloques de aproximadamente 2–3 horas diarias, durante varios días y dentro del horario comercial español. Perfil requerido * Residir en España. * Español natural y buena dicción. * Experiencia en telemarketing, ventas telefónicas o campañas B2B. * Voz agradable, segura y profesional. * Buena organización y manejo básico de Google Sheets. * Posibilidad de emitir factura. * Se valorará experiencia con restaurantes, delivery, hostelería o captación de empresas. Indica en tu propuesta * Tu experiencia en campañas similares. * Tu ciudad de residencia. * Tu precio para preparar la lista de 50 empresas. * Tu tarifa por hora para realizar las llamadas. * Cuántas llamadas puedes realizar aproximadamente por hora. * Tu disponibilidad para comenzar. * Si puedes enviar una breve nota de voz presentando el restaurante como si estuvieras llamando a una empresa. Si la primera prueba ofrece buenos resultados, ampliaremos la campaña con otras empresas y existe posibilidad de colaboración continuada. Presupuesto Presupuesto a convenir según experiencia y propuesta.

opportunities.title: Integrar Pagos Electrónicos en Lavadora
opportunities.description: Dispongo de una lavadora que hoy solo funciona con monedas físicas y quiero modernizarla para atraer más clientes. Necesito añadir dos métodos de cobro adicionales: • Pago con móvil mediante QR • Pago con tarjeta débito o crédito Al confirmarse el pago el equipo debe habilitarse, pero el usuario elegirá el ciclo deseado en el panel habitual antes de que comience a girar. Busco una solución completa que incluya: 1. Selección e instalación del lector o terminal compatible (QR y tarjetas). 2. Diseño del circuito de control que “desbloquee” la lavadora tras el pago, manteniendo intacto el monedero mecánico existente. 3. Firmware o software necesario para gestionar transacciones y enviar la señal de habilitación. 4. Integración con la pasarela de pago correspondiente y pruebas de cobro en vivo. 5. Manual de instalación, diagrama de cableado y guía de usuario final para que pueda replicarlo en otras unidades. Valoro que la electrónica quede protegida contra humedad y vibraciones propias de lavanderías, y que el sistema pueda registrar un historial básico de ventas. Si has trabajado antes con controladoras de lavandería, terminales POS, Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi o soluciones IoT similares, menciona tu experiencia. Espero un prototipo funcional listo para instalar, más soporte remoto durante las primeras puestas en marcha.

opportunities.title: Asesoría Marketing USA Servicios
opportunities.description: Quiero potenciar la presencia de mi empresa de servicios en Estados Unidos y, sobre todo, afinar cómo nos comunicamos con el público B2C. Mi prioridad es mejorar la comunicación y el posicionamiento de la marca para que nuestros mensajes resuenen de manera clara y convincente con consumidores estadounidenses. Lo que necesito de ti: • Revisar y pulir nuestros mensajes clave y la propuesta de valor, adaptándolos a la cultura y expectativas del mercado norteamericano. • Diseñar o actualizar presentaciones, propuestas comerciales y demás materiales de venta (pitch decks, folletos, one-pagers) que transmitan profesionalismo y coherencia de marca. • Optimizar la comunicación con nuestros canales de comercialización y socios, asegurando un discurso unificado en todos los puntos de contacto. Cómo me gustaría trabajar: comienza con una auditoría rápida de la comunicación actual, define una guía de tono y estilo específica para EE. UU. y, a partir de ahí, desarrolla las piezas y plantillas necesarias. Valoraré experiencia comprobable en marketing de servicios dentro del mercado estadounidense, dominio de inglés a nivel nativo o casi nativo y capacidad para entregar archivos editables listos para implementar. Si cuentas con casos de éxito o muestras relevantes, compártelos para evaluar tu enfoque.

opportunities.title: Edición Documental para YouTube
opportunities.description: Busco a alguien que transforme mis grabaciones largas en un video atractivo para mi canal de YouTube. Qué recibirás de mi parte – El video principal sin cortes. Si ya tienes experiencia creando contenido documental para YouTube y sabes dónde encontrar buen material libre de derechos, me encantará ver ejemplos de tu trabajo.

opportunities.title: Meta Ads para Leads de Peluquerías
opportunities.description: Título Especialista en Meta Ads para generar leads de salones de peluquería (B2B) en toda España Descripción Somos una distribuidora de marcas premium de cosmética capilar en España y buscamos a una persona freelance especialista en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) para generar leads de salones de peluquería de toda España (venta B2B). El seguimiento comercial de los leads lo hacemos nosotros. Queremos empezar cuanto antes. Qué harás: Crear y lanzar las campañas de generación de leads (estructura, audiencias y segmentación para toda España). Crear los anuncios: textos y creatividades, con varias versiones para testear. Configurar el formulario de captación (nombre del salón, ciudad, teléfono, correo y marcas que usa). Optimizar y escalar las campañas para conseguir el máximo de leads válidos al menor coste. Enviarnos un informe semanal sencillo (leads, coste por lead y qué anuncios funcionan). Qué es un lead válido: un salón de peluquería interesado en nuestras marcas que rellena el formulario con datos de contacto reales. Qué no incluye: llamar o gestionar los leads ni consultoría de crecimiento. La política de privacidad y el consentimiento del formulario los aportamos nosotros. Condiciones: Inversión publicitaria de prueba de hasta 10.000 €/mes, que pagamos directamente a Meta. Trabajo sobre nuestra cuenta publicitaria, con acceso como colaborador. Tarifa fija mensual durante un periodo de prueba de 3 meses, sin parte variable, con revisión al final del primer mes. Requisitos: Experiencia demostrable en campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads con presupuestos comparables. Casos con resultados (leads y coste por lead), idealmente B2B o negocios locales. Español de nivel nativo o C1.

opportunities.title: Testers en Colombia · Desde tu celular · USD 50 por prueba completada
opportunities.description: Testers en Colombia · Desde tu celular · USD 50 por prueba completada Hola. En Puli AI ayudamos a que las apps financieras funcionen mejor para personas reales. Buscamos una persona en Colombia para probar apps de empresas financieras líderes (incluidas algunas que cotizan en bolsa), con su propia cuenta. En cada prueba se usa la app que asignemos. Qué vas a hacer Esto es más que opinar sobre una app: 1. Te registras una vez en cada app que te asignemos y completas su verificación de identidad con tus propios documentos. Esto pasa dentro de la app: Puli nunca ve tus documentos. 2. Haces el depósito mínimo que pide la app con tu propia tarjeta Visa o Mastercard, crédito o débito. Ese dinero vuelve a la misma tarjeta cuando lo retiras, y te reembolsamos todas las comisiones y costos por cambio de moneda. 3. Retiras ese dinero a la misma tarjeta. 4. Después de cada paso nos escribes por correo qué pasó, con pantallazos donde los datos privados estén tapados. Te enseñamos cómo. Tiempo: te decimos la duración estimada antes de cada prueba. La primera prueba en cada app toma más porque incluye el registro y la verificación. Es una misión de varias semanas, con al menos 2 pruebas por semana, en los horarios que te queden bien. Pago - USD 50 por cada prueba completada, en un plazo máximo de 7 días después de revisar tu prueba. El pago se hace en dólares (USD) a través de Freelancer.com. - Te reembolsamos todas las comisiones de tu tarjeta, las comisiones de la app y los costos por cambio de moneda, también a través de Freelancer.com y en el mismo plazo. El depósito vuelve a tu tarjeta según los tiempos de tu banco y de la app; normalmente unos días hábiles. - Si la prueba falla por un problema de la app, lo revisamos contigo caso por caso. - Trabajas como contratista independiente (prestación de servicios independiente), con un acuerdo de tester que firmas antes de tu primera prueba; tú te encargas de tus propios impuestos. No prometemos un ingreso fijo. Requisitos - Vivir en Colombia y tener un documento de identidad colombiano vigente - Tener 18 años o más - Tarjeta Visa o Mastercard (crédito o débito) de un banco colombiano, a tu nombre - Cualquier celular (iOS o Android) - Hablar español. Algo de inglés es un plus, pero no es obligatorio Tu privacidad Puli nunca te pide ni ve números de tarjeta, números de cuenta, saldos, contraseñas, códigos de verificación ni documentos de identidad. Para inscribirte solo necesitas tu nombre, correo, ciudad y tipo de celular. Puedes pedir que borremos tus datos cuando quieras: escríbenos por el chat de Freelancer.com y lo hacemos en un plazo de 48 horas. Para aplicar, envía tu propuesta aquí en Freelancer.com y cuéntanos tu ciudad y tu tipo de celular.
